newsitem.title: USA: Conrail, Norfolk Southern, CSX to meet.
newsitem.headline: Conrail, Norfolk Southern, CSX to meet.

text.p: Officials of Norfolk Southern Corp, Conrail Inc and CSX Corp will meet Friday to discuss the battle to acquire Conrail, Norfolk Southern Chairman David Goode said Wednesday.
Goode told an analysts' meeting that Conrail and CSX had responded positively to his invitation to meet.
"We have set a meeting Friday and I plan to be there, ready to work hard for a solution," he said.
Reuters monitored the analysts' meeting by telephone.
Goode said he was confident of resolving the dispute although the process would be "very difficult." He reiterated a pledge to obtain for Conrail shareholders a payment of $115 cash per share.
Conrail and CSX have agreed to merge. Norfolk Southern is trying to break up that deal and has made its own bid for Conrail.
"I am open to discussing any number of solutions," Goode told a news conference later. However, he said he could not compromise on his pledge that Conrail shareholders would realize $115 a share.
He also said he would not compromise on his determination to provide "competitive balance" in the Eastern rail market.
He said a Norfolk Southern acquisition of Conrail at its bid price of $115 a share would be the simplest way to meet his pledge to Conrail shareholders.
"If there are other ways, I'm willing to consider them, but we have a pledge to Conrail shareholders," he said.
Goode declined to identify the Conrail, CSX and Norfolk Southern officials who would take part in the meeting Friday.
He also declined to discuss possible outlines of a deal with CSX.
"I'm confident that a structure can be developed for Conrail which will be profitable for both of us," Goode said.
